title: C2 event to C4
description: Sent by C2 for every request it classifies (POST /v1/events/c2), PASS and BLOCK. Not sent when both branches failed (method fail_safe), so infrastructure failures never count against a user.

event_id.description: Unique per event, never reused. C4 drops duplicates. Recommended: evt-cN-<uuid4>

org_id.description: Hospital id, copied from the request

user_id.description: User id, copied from the request

request_id.description: Request id created by the gateway, copied from the request

session_id.description: Session id created by the gateway, copied from the request

c2_score.description: The score C2 used for its verdict: the similarity score when the near-exact override fired, otherwise the ensemble score. Sent for PASS too
